launcher_command:
import ctypes,os,sys; from pathlib import Path; from tools import vl
kernel=ctypes.WinDLL("kernel32",use_last_error=True)
kernel.GetCurrentProcess.restype=ctypes.c_void_p
kernel.SetProcessAffinityMask.argtypes=[ctypes.c_void_p,ctypes.c_size_t]
if not kernel.SetProcessAffinityMask(kernel.GetCurrentProcess(),1 << 2): raise ctypes.WinError(ctypes.get_last_error())
sys.argv=["vl","bench","--escape-compare","--report",str(Path(os.environ["TEMP"])/"vela-escape-comparison.json"),"--","--benchmark_min_time=0.5s","--benchmark_repetitions=7"]
raise SystemExit(vl.main())

measurement.timing: Median wall nanoseconds per invocation; compilation and setup excluded in escape cases
measurement.allocation: Separate warmed Isolate, automatic GC disabled, one invocation delta
measurement.gc_work: Full collection time and reclaimed objects after the controlled allocation sample
measurement.frames: Declared pre-LLVM storage, including private borrow entries; not physical stack high-water mark
measurement.code: Linked executable/read-only/writable block contents; excludes allocator page padding
measurement.diagnostic_instrumentation: No runtime allocation counters inserted into timed paths
measurement.timing_limit: Some configurations have CV around 25%; do not interpret small differences

comparison_to_previous.reason: Different benchmark suite and CPU-affinity settings

benchmark_context.luajit_build: upstream amalgamation; default allocator; no FFI workloads

measurement.timing: Median wall nanoseconds; small startup includes compilation, execution cases exclude it. Cache batches use distinct canonical source files and independent Isolates.
measurement.memory: GC allocated/committed bytes sampled after execution and retained bytes after collection; no claim of instantaneous matcher stack high-water usage.
measurement.process_peak: Separate fresh processes for concurrency 1 and 4; resident high-water includes compilation and all repetitions in that process.
measurement.unordered_matching: The 3x3 overlapping matcher case evaluates all nine candidate pairs before one-to-one matching.
